purpose: Measure how potently a compound inhibits a purified protein kinase (IC50): kinase + peptide substrate + ATP, then ADP-Glo converts the ADP formed into light, so inhibitors lower the luminescence.
notes: Four of the five exemplars are Broad Institute MLPCN assays (one assay family); 686948 is an NCGC qHTS assay. Source diversity is low.
ATP and enzyme are chosen per kinase (ATP near its Km, see rule:agm/substrate_at_km), so their observed values are not defaults to copy.
AID 588811 states 'final reactant concentrations were 10 uM ADP'; from the 1:1 mix of a 20 uM ATP solution this is presumably ATP (a typo in the AID).

Top concentration: 623998/623999 interleave two dilution series in one test; their top (46 uM) is the highest tested. 686948 (qHTS) is left out of the series parameters because its concentration columns pool many plate series.
